column12: USE OF 6-PHOSPHOGLUCONIC ACID AND DERIVATIVE THEREOF IN PREPARING MEDICAMENT FOR PREVENTING OR TREATING GLYCOMETABOLISM DISORDER DISEASES

column12: Dual-stimulus-response polymer micelle as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a dual stimuli-responsive polymer micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The micelle is jointly formed by a phenylboronic acid modified polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether-(alpha-propargyl-delta-valerolactone-lactide) copolymer and a catechol modified polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether-(alpha-propargyl-delta-valerolactone-lactide) copolymer, wherein the phenylboronic acid modified polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether-(alpha-propargyl-delta-valerolactone-lactide) copolymer is used for modifying the phenylboronic acid; when the micelle is formed, pH and ROS can be formed in a hydrophobic core to stimulate corresponding boric acid ester bonds; the micelle is used for loading hydrophobic antitumor drugs. The polymer micelle prepared by the invention can be stable in an in-vivo circulating physiological environment, and makes stimulation response to a tumor microenvironment to cause structure loosening or dissociation, so that effective delivery of hydrophobic antitumor drugs is realized, the problems of instability of the micelle in vivo and drug pre-leakage are effectively solved, and the drug delivery efficiency is improved. Theoretical and practical basis is provided for promoting cancer treatment of a polymer micelle drug delivery system.

column12: Double-sensitive type co-loaded emodin and chlorambucil micelle as well as preparation method and application of double-sensitive type co-loaded emodin and chlorambucil micelle
column13: The invention belongs to the field of nano-drug delivery systems, and particularly relates to a double-sensitive type co-loaded emodin and chlorambucil micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the polymer is as follows: polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether, p-hydroxymethyl phenylboronic acid pinacol ester and emodin grafted dendritic polymer p (mPEG-co-HPBE-co-EMD) are designed and synthesized by taking polymethacrylate as a connecting unit, and the dendritic polymer p (mPEG-co-HPBE-co-EMD) is used for entrapment of chlorambucil. column12: LIVING CELL DRUG DELIVERY SYSTEM, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND USE THEREOF
column13: A living cell drug delivery system, a preparation method therefor, and use thereof. The living cell drug delivery system comprises carrier cells, polymer micelles, and a metal polyphenol network coating. The polymer micelles are loaded on the surface of the carrier cells, and the metal polyphenol network coating covers the surface of the polymer micelles. The raw materials of the metal polyphenol network coating comprise a first metal salt, a second metal salt and a polyphenol.

column12: Plasmid encoding a c-terminal fragment of paraspeckle component 1 for treating tumors
column13: An isolated nucleic acid encoding a C-terminal fragment of paraspeckle component 1 (PSPC1) is disclosed. The C-terminal fragment of the PSPC1 comprises an extension of more than 10 but no greater than 131 amino acid residues with its C-terminal amino acid identical to the C-terminus of the PSPC1 sequence SEQ ID NO: 3 and exhibits a biological activity against tumor cells. The tumor cells are associated with either PSPC1 or protein tyrosine kinase 6 (PTK6), or both. The anti-tumor activity is at least one selected from the group consisting of: (a) suppressing tumor cell growth; (b) suppressing tumor cell progression; (c) suppressing tumor cell metastasis; (d) decreasing PSPC1 expression; and (e) decreasing oncogenic PTK6 expression in cytoplasm. Also disclosed is a peptide comprising a C-terminal fragment sequence of PSPC1. A reagent kit and method for predicting tumor progression, metastasis, and prognosis in a cancer patient are also disclosed.

column12: Multifunctional injectable composite hydrogel loaded with active oxygen response polymer micelle as well as preparation method and application of multifunctional injectable composite hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses multifunctional injectable composite hydrogel loaded with active oxygen response polymeric micelles and a preparation method and application of the multifunctional injectable composite hydrogel, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical hydrogels, oxidized hyaluronic acid, modified chitosan and active oxygen sensitive micelles are fused in the hydrogel, and intelligent regulation and control over the rheumatoid arthritis microenvironment are achieved. Through a dual crosslinking technology, the hydrogel not only has improved mechanical strength, but also has shape adaptation and self-repairing capabilities. Due to introduction of the active oxygen response micelle, drug release is intelligent, the release rate is adjusted according to the level of active oxygen in joints, and the curative effect is enhanced; the hydrogel can accurately locate an inflamed joint, intelligently release drugs, reduce side effects, induce polarization of M2 macrophages, improve an inflammatory microenvironment and realize collaborative treatment, intelligent controlled release and long-term stability of the hydrogel provide a new strategy for precision medicine, and the hydrogel is expected to show huge potential in treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and has broad application prospects. Important clinical application values and market prospects are realized.

column12: Folic acid modified pH/reduction dual-response selenium-containing mixed polymer cross-linked micelle as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of polymer micelles, and discloses a folic acid modified pH/reduction dual-response selenium-containing mixed polymer cross-linked micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The selenium-containing mixed polymer cross-linked micelle takes polycaprolactone (PCL) and methacrylic acid N, N-diethylaminoethyl ester (DEAEMA) as a core, and other block structures comprise polyethylene glycol (PEG), polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether monomethacrylate (PEGMA), hydroxyethyl methylacrylate (PHEM), folic acid (FA) and selenium caprylic acid (SA). After an anti-cancer drug adriamycin is loaded, the selenium-containing mixed polymer cross-linked micelle can stably exist in a neutral environment of normal tissues of a human body, has less drug leakage, can be actively recognized by tumor cells at a tumor part, is accumulated and endocytosed, and smoothly releases the drug; the technical problems that in the prior art, the stability, the drug controlled release and the targeting performance of polymer drug-loaded micelles still need to be improved are solved to a certain extent.

column12: Preparation method and application of targeted polypeptide modified nano drug delivery system (PDC) specifically combined with neurotensin specific receptor (NTR)

column12: Dual-targeting/drug-loading tumor reduction sensitive nano-carrier and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a dual-targeting/drug-loading reduction sensitive nano-carrier, which is a micelle with a particle size range of 100-140 nm, the micelle is composed of a micelle prepared from a block polymer by a solvent evaporation method, the multi-block polymer is Tel-PEG-ss-PCL, the hydrophilic end is PEG with a targeting group Tel, the hydrophobic end is PCL, the multi-block polymer is of a core-shell structure, the core is the hydrophobic end PCL, the hydrophilic end is PEG with a targeting group Tel, the hydrophobic end is PCL, the hydrophilic end is PEG with targeting group Tel, the hydrophobic end is PCL, and the hydrophilic end is PEG with targeting group Tel. And the shell is a hydrophilic block with a targeting group Tel. According to the nano-carrier, polymer micelles with hydrophilic end polyethylene glycol and hydrophobic end polycaprolactone are selected as a drug carrier to improve the problem of poor water solubility of drugs; an angiotensin type II receptor (AT1R) ligand telmisartan (Tel) is used for simultaneously targeting and overexpressing CAFs and tumor cells of AT1R, killing the tumor cells and the CAFs and double-loading drugs so as to overcome drug resistance; meanwhile, disulfide bonds are used for responding to high-concentration glutathione (GSH) in tumor cells, so that accurate controlled release of the medicine in the cells is realized. The nano-carrier realizes the treatment effects of solubilization of insoluble drugs, dual targeting of tumors and CAFs and drug resistance reversal, and shows a good anti-tumor effect in vivo and in vitro.

column12: Oxidation response core cross-linked polymer micelle as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an oxidation response core cross-linked polymer micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof, the structural general formula of the micelle is mPEG-PTK, mPEG is methoxypolyethylene glycol with the molecular weight of 800-4000 Da, and PTK is polythioketal. The preparation method comprises the following steps: reacting 3, 3 '-(propane-2, 2-diyl bis (sulfanediyl)) dipropanol with 2-(bromomethyl) methyl acrylate to obtain a polymeric monomer TK containing a thioketal structure, selecting mPEG with good biocompatibility as a hydrophilic block, and performing catalytic synthesis by Novozym 435 enzyme to obtain a polymer mPEG-PTK; and then adding a cross-linking agent and a photoinitiator, and preparing the oxidation response core cross-linked polymer micelle under an illumination condition. The oxidation response type core cross-linked polymer micelle prepared by the invention can effectively solve the problem of structural dissociation caused by mass dilution of blood in the existing micelle, and provides a new way for developing the synthesis of stimuli-responsive drug carriers.

column12: Tumor-targeting rhizoma bletillae polysaccharide polymer nano-micelle as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a tumor-targeting rhizoma bletillae polysaccharide polymer nano-micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, bletilla striata polysaccharide and vitamin E succinate are self-assembled in water to form a polymer nano-micelle which is a drug delivery system with tumor targeting and biodegradability. The rhizoma bletillae polysaccharide is a main active ingredient of traditional Chinese medicine rhizoma bletillae, is a natural degradable high polymer material, has anti-tumor activity, can play a role of integrating medicines and auxiliary materials, and can solve the safety problem of long-term retention of an invalid carrier in vivo due to the fact that the raw materials are degradable; vitamin E succinate is used as a raw material for hydrophobic modification of rhizoma bletillae polysaccharide and construction of polymer micelles, also has antitumor activity and can play a synergistic effect.

column12: DRUG-LOADED BIODEGRADABLE MICROBEAD COMPOSITIONS INCLUDING DRUG-CONTAINING VESICULAR AGENTS
column13: Drug-loaded microbead compositions include microbeads of a water-swellable polymer material and a complex of a carrier and a therapeutic agent chemically bonded to the carrier. The complex is embedded in the polymer material. Methods for preparing the drug-loaded microbead compositions and embolization compositions include loading a therapeutic agent into a water-swellable polymer material to form microbeads, then removing water from the microbeads. Additional drug-loaded microbead compositions include microbeads of a biodegradable material, vesicular agents, a first therapeutic agent associated with the vesicular agents, and a second therapeutic agent different from the first therapeutic agent. The vesicular agents include a lipid bilayer surrounding a vesicular core. The second therapeutic agent is contained within the microbeads or associated with the microbeads through ionic or non-covalent interaction and may or may not be associated with the vesicular agents. Drug-loaded biodegradable microbead compositions include microbeads of biodegradable material and a therapeutic agent.

column13: Provided herein is a process for preparing a homogeneous conjugate of an antibody or antibody-like protein via linkage of cysteine sites between heavy-light chains in the IgG antibody or antibody-like protein. It also relates to methods of using the homogeneous conjugate in targeted prophylaxis or treatment of cancer, infection and immunological disorders.

column12: POLYMERIC MICELLE NANOPARTICLES FOR ON-DEMAND CELLULAR PACKAGING OF EXTRACELLULAR VESICLES
column13: Developing therapeutic cancer vaccines to modulate immune responses for cancer treatment has gained increasing interest. However, to date, such cancer vaccines suffer from weak immunogencity, low specificity, and off-target effects. Developing novel cancer vaccines is needed for precise control of anti-tumor immune responses. Described are polymeric micelle nanoparticles and their use in producing extracellular vesicles containing a cargo molecule, The cargo-loaded extracellular vesicles can be used as therapeutic delivery vectors.

column12: Liver targeting polymer micelle drug delivery system as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a liver targeting polymer micelle drug delivery system as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The drug delivery system is characterized in that acryloyl carbonate and lactone are subjected to ring opening polymerization to form a double-bond modifiable polymer, then the double-bond modifiable polymer is modified by a zwitterionic material and a cholic acid derivative to form two modified polymers, and the two modified polymers are loaded with insulin and berberine hydrochloride in a self-assembly mode and then subjected to ultraviolet crosslinking to form the insulin-loaded berberine-modified drug delivery system. The liver targeting polymer micelle drug delivery system is formed. The polymer micelle drug delivery system takes a cholic acid derivative as a targeting carrier, and berberine hydrochloride promotes glucose consumption and glucose uptake induced by insulin. Through combined use of berberine hydrochloride and insulin, the dosage of insulin can be reduced, the risk of hypoglycemia is reduced, the sensitivity of insulin is increased, and the hypoglycemic effect is synergistically improved. A cross-linked structure is formed through ultraviolet irradiation, so that the gastric acid resistance of insulin and berberine hydrochloride is improved, the stability of polymer micelles is improved, burst release is avoided, and long-acting blood glucose reduction is realized.

column13: The invention discloses a novel double-drug-loading mesoporous silica nanoparticle system and application thereof in cancer treatment, and mainly solves the technical problems that in the prior art, an adjustable low critical transition temperature LCST of F127 is low and is less than 37 DEG C due to a relatively short hydrophobic PPO chain segment, and the drug loading capacity of MSN modified by a polymer is reduced, so that the service life of the MSN is prolonged. And their use as a drug delivery system is limited. The temperature response polymer micelle prepared by the invention is used as a'switch 'after being loaded with DOX, and is grafted on the surfaces of DOX-loaded mesoporous silica nanoparticles through disulfide bonds to form a double-drug-loading nano system. By means of the scheme, the LCST temperature is increased, and high drug loading capacity and outstanding stimulation response performance are achieved.

column12: Preparation of rifampicin nano drug delivery system and application of rifampicin nano drug delivery system in prevention and treatment of Parkinson's disease
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano drug delivery systems, and particularly relates to preparation of a rifampicin nano drug delivery system and application of the rifampicin nano drug delivery system to prevention and treatment of Parkinson's disease. Rifampicin is loaded into a PEG-PCL nano drug delivery system for the first time, and the PEG-PCL nano drug delivery system is prepared into polymeric micelles; tTBZ molecules are modified on the surface of the polymer micelle and can be specifically combined with VMAT2. Compared with a traditional rifampicin medicament type, the carrier (PEG-PCL) is weak in cytotoxicity, the micelle formed by a PEG-PCL hydrophilic block has the structural characteristics of a hydrophobic inner core and a hydrophilic outer core, the water solubility of the rifampicin is increased, and the stability of the rifampicin circulating in a body is improved; the rifampicin nano-particle has a targeting drug delivery capability, and improves the local aggregation concentration of rifampicin in dopaminergic neurons, so that the bioavailability of the drug is improved, the protection effect of the drug on neurological diseases such as Parkinson's disease is improved, and the peripheral toxic and side effects of the drug are reduced.

column13: The invention discloses a targeting polymer micelle capable of realizing active oxygen responsive drug release in an inflammatory microenvironment and a preparation method thereof. column12: Soluble microneedle-mediated shikonin-loaded transdermal drug delivery system and preparation thereof
column13: The invention discloses a soluble microneedle-mediated shikonin-loaded transdermal drug delivery system and a preparation method thereof. The shikonin-loaded polymer micelle comprises a hyaluronic acid-ursolic acid-N-trityl-L-histidine methyl ester hydrochloride segmented copolymer micelle and the shikonin loaded on the hyaluronic acid-ursolic acid-N-trityl-L-histidine methyl ester hydrochloride segmented copolymer micelle. column12: Application of nano-targeted polymer micelle in preparation of targeted drug delivery system
column13: The invention provides application of nano-targeted polymer micelle in preparation of a targeted drug delivery system. column12: Daphnoretin micelle and preparation method, content detection and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a daphnoretin micelle and a preparation method, content detection and application thereof. The daphnoretin nano-micelle is prepared by selecting a safe and degradable material PEG-PLA, and daphnoretin is prepared into a polymer micelle so as to achieve the purposes of increasing solubility and prolonging in-vivo action time. Meanwhile, the glycyrrhetinic acid coupled PEG-PLA is used as a carrier, and the nano preparation which is loaded with daphnoretin and has the liver cancer targeting property is prepared. Through in-vitro cell research, in-vivo targeting evaluation and preliminary pharmacodynamic research on the two drug-loaded micelles, the liver targeting drug delivery performance and the anti-tumor effect of the daphnoretin nano-micelle drug system are proved, and a theoretical basis is laid for in-vivo liver cancer targeting research of daphnoretin in the future; and a new thought is provided for the development of a new daphnoretin dosage form and a novel liver cancer targeting preparation.

column12: Amphiphilic polymers drug delivery system and tumor treatment system using the same
column13: The present invention relates to an amphiphilic polymer compound, and a drug carrier and a tumor treatment system using the same. More specifically, the amphiphilic polymer compound of the present invention contains a thioketal linker, thereby being able to be decomposed selectively and efficiently by sensitively reacting to reactive oxygen species (ROS), and forming polymer micelles in an aqueous phase, it is possible to provide a drug carrier that contains a drug in a hydrophobic core, has excellent selective accumulation into target cancer cells, has low toxicity, and is capable of photodynamic therapy and chemical drug therapy at the same time. Another objective of the present invention is to provide the tumor treatment system using the same.

The invention also relates to methods of making such linkers, and of using such linkers in making homogeneous conjugates, as well as of application of the conjugates in treatment of cancers, infections and autoimmune disorders.

column12: Drug targeting polymeric micelle as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an enzyme-linked drug targeting polymeric micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of drug carriers. The micelle takes a hyaluronic acid-glycyrrhetinic acid polymer as a carrier, collagenase is connected to the surface of the polymer by a chemical bonding method, an anti-hepatic fibrosis drug is physically entrapped in the polymer, the polymeric micelle is constructed by a nanotechnology to deliver the anti-hepatic fibrosis drug, specifically targets the main effector cells of liver fibrosis, hepatic stellate cells, through the hyaluronic acid shell of the micelle, and with the help of collagenase, the polymeric micelle can penetrate a fibrosis collagen barrier and achieve the purpose of efficient targeted delivery of the anti-hepatic fibrosis drug to the liver, so that the drug delivery carrier disclosed by the invention has higher drug delivery efficiency, and the problem that hepatic stellate cells are difficult to deliver is solved.

column12: Phospholipid hybrid polymer micelle capable of being co-loaded with immunologic adjuvant and indocyanine green and having targeting effect, and preparation method and application of phospholipid hybrid polymer micelle
column13: The invention discloses a phospholipid hybrid polymer micelle capable of being co-loaded with immunologic adjuvant and indocyanine green and having a targeting effect, and a preparation method and application of the phospholipid hybrid polymer micelle. The method comprises the following steps of: dissolving PCL-s-PEG-s-PCL, hydrophobic ICG, DSPE-PEG-COOH, MnO2, NLG919 and a TLR4 agonist in an organic solvent, performing ultrasonic treatment, removing an organic solvent, and forming a layer of uniform thin film; drying the thin film, and carrying out hydration, ultrasonic treatment and dialysis in sequence to obtain a nanoparticle micelle solution; and activating carboxyl groups on the surfaces of the nanoparticle micelles in the nanoparticle micelle solution, adding NH2-RGD into the nanoparticle micelle solution for incubation, and dialyzing to obtain the phospholipid hybrid polymer micelle capable of being co-loaded with the immunologic adjuvants (NLG919 and MPLA) and the indocyanine green and having the targeting effect. According to the method, hydrophobic drugs (ICG and NLG919) are effectively wrapped in an inner cavity, an immune agonist is embedded into a phospholipid layer, and aminated polypeptide arginine-glycine-aspartic acid is modified on the surface of a carrier, and therefore, the nano-drug carrier effectively aiming at phototherapy and immunotherapy of malignant tumors is formed.

column12: PEPTIDE-CONJUGATED NANOPARTICLES FOR TARGETING, IMAGING, AND TREATMENT OF PROSTATE CANCER
column13: An isolated or a synthetic targeting peptide comprising an amino acid sequence that is at least 90% identical to SEQ ID NO: 8 is disclosed. The targeting peptide may be conjugated to a component selected from the group consisting of polymeric micelles, lipoprotein-based drug carriers, nanoparticle drug carriers, a chemotherapeutic agent, a micelle, a liposome, dendrimers, a polymer, a lipid, an oligonucleotide, a peptide, a polypeptide, a protein, a prostate cancer cell, a stem cell, and an imaging agent. Also disclosed are a kit for imaging and detecting the presence of prostate cancer cells in vivo or in vitro, and a composition for treating prostate cancer, inhibiting prostate cancer cell growth, inducing prostate cancer cell cytotoxicity, and/or increasing the survival rate in a prostate cancer patient.

column12: Antitumor drug delivery formulation
column13: This invention provides an antitumor drug delivery formulation for treating a subject having a tumor more highly expressing a TUG1 gene than normal tissues or preventing the subject from tumor metastasis, comprising a polymeric micelle comprising a nucleic acid that suppresses high expression of the TUG1 gene as an active ingredient, wherein the polymeric micelle comprises a block copolymer having a cationic poly(amino acid) segment and a hydrophilic polymer chain segment and the nucleic acid, and wherein the nucleic acid is bound to a cationic group of the cationic poly(amino acid) segment to form a complex and/or the nucleic acid is incorporated in the micelle or attached into the micelle; and the polymeric micelle accumulates in the tumor.

column12: A Composition for Solubilizing Alpinumisoflavone and Uses Thereof
column13: The present invention relates to a composition for solubilizing alpinumisoflavone and a use thereof. A drug carrier composition or a composition for solubilizing alpinumisoflavone according to the present invention uses polymer micelles formed through association of mPEG-b-PLA and can effectively solubilize alpinumisoflavone. Alpinumisoflavone is a hardly soluble material, and substantially does not exist in an aqueous layer but is enclosed in the micelles and solubilized. In this manner, alpinumisoflavone which is a hardly soluble material can be dissolved in an aqueous layer and developed as an intravenous injection formulation using water. Since the intravenous injection can avoid a liver first pass effect, as compared to an oral administration formulation, to reduce undesired drug loss, and shows increased bio-availability as compared to an oral administration formulation, it is an effective administration method capable of expecting a higher effect with the same dose of drug. Therefore, development of such a formulation allows effective administration of alpinumisoflavone. In addition, the composition according to the present invention shows a controlled release effect of alpinumisoflavone in the micelles, and such an effect enables increased retention of the drug in vivo. Further, the composition according to the present invention shows no toxicity, and has an advantage in that it can reduce the toxicity caused by an excipient by using a polymer.

column12: Self-assembled gel acne-removing microneedle patch as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the field of medical cosmetics, and relates to an acne-removing microneedle, in particular to a self-assembled gel acne-removing microneedle patch as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, standing and self-assembling a small molecule regulator and a polymer micelle carrying a hydrophobic drug to prepare chitosan-natural anion polysaccharide natural hydrogel with excellent mechanical properties; and secondly, constructing the acne-removing microneedle patch which is painless, efficient and controllable in administration and has antibacterial and repairing functions from the natural hydrogel by adopting a vacuum injection method. The self-assembled gel not only avoids the use of a chemical cross-linking agent, but also improves the utilization rate of the hydrophobic drug. After the constructed gel acne-removing microneedle acts on the skin, a needle body and a base can be rapidly separated, the hydrophobic drug can be controllably released, and the risk caused by pulling out the needle body again to a wound is avoided.

column12: Cell-penetrating peptide modified drug carrier as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a cell-penetrating peptide modified drug carrier as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations. The drug carrier is a polymer micelle formed by self-assembly of a short-chain amphiphilic block copolymer and a long-chain amphiphilic block copolymer, wherein the short-chain amphiphilic block copolymer and the long-chain amphiphilic block copolymer can be modified by an activatable cell-penetrating peptide; the activatable cell-penetrating peptide is HE-CPP, the amino acid sequence of the activatable cell-penetrating peptide is C (HE) 10G5-CPP, and the CPP is a section of amino acid sequence containing arginine, lysine or a combination of arginine and lysine. column12: Construction and application of endoplasmic reticulum targeted nano drug delivery system
column13: The invention provides construction and application of an endoplasmic reticulum targeted nano drug delivery system. By modifying sulfamide or sulfonylurea compounds with endoplasmic reticulum tendencyinto endoplasmic reticulum targeting nano-compounds constructed in a nano-carrier, the constructed novel endoplasmic reticulum targeting liposome can load water-soluble and fat-soluble drugs and quickly transfer the drugs to the endoplasmic reticulum part, so that accumulation of the drugs at the action part of the liposome is improved, and the bioavailability of the drugs is improved. The medicine treatment effect is enhanced, and the toxic and side effect is weakened; the delivery of nucleic acid drugs needing lysosome escape can be remarkably improved, and a new strategy is provided for exerting the curative effect of the drugs. The nano-carrier disclosed by the invention is not only limited to lipidosome, but also can be solid lipid nanoparticles, nano-emulsion, polymer micelles and the like. The endoplasmic reticulum targeted modification nano-carrier provided by the invention is novel in scheme and simple in preparation method, and has good industrial production and applicationprospects.

column12: Switch type glucose-responsive double-layer cross-linked polymeric micelle drug delivery system and preparation method and application thereof

column12: Artemisinin B polymer micelle preparation and preparation and characterization method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an artemisinin B polymer micelle preparation and a preparation and characterization method thereof. A raw material used by the preparation is artemisinin B, and an auxiliary material is an amphiphilic block copolymer formed by polymerizing polyethylene glycol and polylactic acid in different proportions. The artemisinin B polymer micelle preparation is prepared by adoptingmembrane hydration, and the preparation process is simple. The obtained preparation can solubilize a hydrophobic artemisinin B compound and is good in uniformity and high in encapsulation efficiency.In-vitro release degree research shows that the micelle preparation has a certain slow release effect compared with a pure raw material medicine. In addition, compared with other artemisinin B preparations and other medicinal preparations prepared by traditional technical schemes, the preparation of the invention has the obvious advantages of good stability, high safety and the like, and has a wide application prospect in artemisinin B sustained-release preparations and antitumor medicinal preparations.

column12: Hypoxia-sensitive nitrobenzenized chitosan and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides hypoxia-sensitive nitrobenzenized chitosan and a preparation method and application thereof. The weight-average molecular weight of the chitosan is 5000-18000Da, and a graftingrate of nitrobenzene is 5.3-14.8%. Chitosan with good biocompatibility is used as a hydrophilic material, 6-aminocaproic acid is used as a bridging group, nitrobenzene is selected as an oxygen deficitsensitive group, and nitrobenzene chitosan with oxygen deficit sensitive responsiveness is synthesized. The nitrobenzene chitosan can be self-assembled into polymer micelles in water, can be used asan excellent drug carrier with good biological safety, efficiently encapsulates a variety of cytotoxic drugs, and rapidly depolymerizes and releases the drugs under the action of nitroreductase in anoxic tumor cells, so as to realize targeted rapid release of the drugs and improve the drug effect. The nitrobenzene chitosan disclosed by the invention has a structural formula shown in the specification,

column12: Preparation of PVA (polyvinyl alcohol) reversibly crosslinked drug-loaded micelle with triple response
column13: The invention provides synthesis of an amphiphilic linear block copolymer with pH, reduction and hydrogen peroxide triple stimulus response, and a preparation method and application of a polymer micelle for reversible crosslinking of a shell layer by utilizing polyvinyl alcohol (PVA). The amphiphilic block copolymer (PBA-co-PDMAEMA)-b-PLA-SS-PLA-b-(PDMAEMA-co-PBA) is prepared by a ring opening polymerization method and an electron transfer activation regeneration atom transfer free radical polymerization method. The carfilzomib-containing micellar freeze-dried preparation comprises carfilzomib as an effective component and polymer micelles as a drug carrier. The invention avoids using Sulfobutylether-beta-Cyclodextrin or other betadex derivatives as auxiliary materials, but active ingredients are loaded into the nano-scale micelles to increase the solubility and stability of carfilzomib and avoid potential safety hazards of existing preparations. In addition, the micellar freeze-dried preparation for intravenous injection in the invention has uniform particle size with a distribution range of 10-35nm. The particle size helps enhance penetration of tumor cells and can increase the enrichment concentration of the drug in tumor tissues and promote targeted release of the active ingredients. The preparation of the inventionhas stable quality and is clinically used for the treatment of multiple myeloma.

column12: PARASPECKLE COMPONENT 1 (PSPC1) PROMOTING EPITHELIAL-MESENCHYMAL TRANSITION, STEMNESS AND METASTASIS AS AN ANTI-CANCER TARGET
column13: An isolated nucleic acid encoding a C-terminal fragment of paraspeckle component 1 (PSPC1) is disclosed. Also disclosed is a peptide comprising a C-terminal fragment sequence of PSPC1. A reagent kit and method for predicting tumor progression, metastasis, and prognosis in a cancer patient are also disclosed.

column12: Adenosine monophosphate AMP complex and application thereof in preparation of tumor targeting nano-drug delivery system

Experimental results show that the AMP complex can cross brain capillary endothelial cells, are specifically absorbed by tumor tissues and have good intracerebral delivery and tumor targeting and imaging functions. The AMP-modified drug and the nano-drug delivery system have remarkable advantages in targeting brain tumors, and have good application prospects in targeting diagnosis and treatment of tumors.

column12: Y-shaped multifunctional targeting polypeptide and application of Y-shaped multifunctional targeting polypeptide to construction of tumor targeted drug delivery system
column13: The invention belongs to the field of pharmacy, and relates to a Y-shaped multifunctional targeting polypeptide and application of the Y-shaped multifunctional targeting polypeptide to construction ofa drug delivery system. The invention provides preparation of the multifunctional targeting polypeptide AG, preparation of AG-modified medicines and AG-modified polymer carrier materials, and application of the multifunctional targeting polypeptide to construction of the drug delivery system for tumor imaging and targeted therapy. Results show that the AG can target tumor angiogenesis and cross blood-tumor barriers, and can also target tumor mimicry vessels, tumor cells and tumor stem cells; a nano drug delivery system constructed through the AG-modified polymer carrier materials, such as lipidosome, polymeric micelles, polymeric discs and nanoparticles, can effectively deliver entrapped drugs to tumor tissue, such as tumor angiogenesis, mimicry vessels, tumor cells and tumor stem cells,and the anti-tumor drug efficacy is remarkably improved; the AG can mediate drugs or the nano drug delivery system to cross the blood-tumor barriers so as to actively target tumors, and the advantageof the tumor targeting effect is outstanding.

column12: Tumor targeted and pH responded polymer micelle and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a tumor targeted and pH responded polymer micelle and a preparation method thereof. The tumor targeted and pH responded polymer micelle comprises a ligand modified first polymer carrier which has target capacity on a biological marker namely phosphatidylserine on the surfaces of various tumor cell membranes, a ligand is one of Annexin V, PSBP-6, hexapeptide and PGN635, andthe first polymer carrier is an amphipathic block copolymer formed from a hydrophilic segment and a hydrophobic segment. The preparation method comprises the preparation process of the target ligand modified first polymer carrier which has affinity on the biological marker namely the phosphatidylserine on the surfaces of the cell membranes. The polymer micelle is actively accumulated in the tumortissue through reinforcing permeation and retention effects, longer second polymer carriers in a mixed micelle structure are depolymerized, the target ligand is exposed, and specific target tumor cells as an antitumor carrier have high stability, high medicine loading capacity, long-acting controlled-release capacity and high target capacity.

column12: Liver cancer targeted ginsenoside-carrying CK chitosan polymer micelle drug delivery system and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a liver cancer targeted ginsenoside-carrying CK chitosan polymer micelle drug delivery system and a preparation method thereof. The drug delivery system comprises a targeting head group, a basic carrier and anticancer drug, the targeting head group is A54 polypeptide, the basic carrier is amphipathic polymer, the anticancer drug is ginsenside CK, the targeting head group isconnected with a hydrophobic end of the basic carrier through a connection group to form a drug delivery carrier, and the drug delivery carrier entraps ginsenoside CK to form the drug delivery system.The drug delivery system prepared by the method can obviously improve water solubility of ginsenside CK, can actively target liver cancer cells and is of important significance in clinical treatmentof liver cancer.

column12: Means and methods for targeted x-ray therapy
column13: The present invention provides a method for activating a pro-drug in vivo comprising the steps of: (a) administering a pro-drag to a subject; (b) locating a target site which has been at least partially dosed with the pro-drug at a predetermined concentration; and (d) exposing the target site to X-ray radiation. The step of exposing the target site to X-ray radiation is characterized by providing a converging X-ray of a controllable waist, substantially uniform at the target site, sufficient to convert the pro-drug to an active drug, while the X-ray photon dosage at the target site is higher than the X-ray photon dosage at an adjacent non target site.

column12: Triple stimulation responsive core cross-linked polymeric micelle as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a triple stimulation responsive core cross-linked polymeric micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the micelle is as shown in the description, wherein x is an integer of 30 to 70, y is an integer of 20 to 50 and the value of x1 is 20% to 50% of that of the x. According to the preparation method, an amphipathic diblock polymer is obtained through atom transfer radical polymerization (ATRP), and is modified by utilizing an azidation reaction; an azidation product can self-assemble to form a core-shell structure in water;and the light, oxidation and reduction triple stimulation responsive core cross-linked polymeric micelle is obtained through click chemistry under the action of a cross-linking agent with redox sensitiveness, anhydrous cupric sulfate and sodium ascorbate. The triple stimulation responsive core cross-linked polymeric micelle provided by the invention has favorable in-vitro stability, can be used for realizing a high-efficiency controlled release behavior of a hydrophobic drug under the double stimulation of light and oxidation or reduction, and has favorable application prospects in the aspects of the delivery and the controlled release of a hydrophobic anti-cancer drug.

column12: DRUG DELIVERY POLYMER MICELLES
column13: The present invention relates to: a compound that is formed by linking the α carbonyl group of aspartic acid directly or via a linker to at least 50% of all of the terminal groups of a dendritic polymer that has a plurality of terminal groups by means of a peptide bond or an ester linkage, by linking a hydrophilic polymer segment directly or via a linker to at least 3% of the total of the terminal amino groups from the aspartic acid and the terminal groups of the dendritic polymer not modified with aspartic acid, and linking a hydrophobic segment directly or via a linker to at least 1% of the total of the terminal amino groups from the aspartic acid and the terminal groups of the dendritic polymer not modified with aspartic acid; and a drug delivery carrier that comprises polymer micelles that self-assemble from the compound. The drug delivery carrier forms micelles when mixed with a drug and thereby makes it possible for the drug to be selectively delivered to bones, which makes it possible to provide useful medicine for the treatment of various bone diseases.

column12: METHOD FOR PREPARING POLYMERIC MICELLE CONTAINING ANIONIC DRUG
column13: Disclosed is a method for preparing a composition for an anionic drug delivery with increased production yield, comprising forming nanoparticles by using electrostatic interaction of an anionic drug and a cationic compound in an aqueous phase; and incorporating the nanoparticles into polymeric micelles comprising an amphiphilic polymer and optionally a polylactic acid salt to increase the electrostatic interaction and hydrophobic binding, thereby increasing the entrapment efficiency of the anionic drug in the formulation.

column12: Hyaluronic acid-methotrexate self-assembled nanomicelle and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano pharmaceutical preparations and discloses a hyaluronic acid-methotrexate self-assembled nanomicelle and a preparation method thereof. Hyaluronic acid and methotrexate are connected through disulfide-bond cystamine to prepare the hyaluronic acid-methotrexate self-assembled nanomicelle through dialysis. By adoption of the disulfide-bond cystamineas a linkage factor, MTX and hyaluronic acid are connected to form the self-assembled nanomicelle, on the one hand, hyaluronic acid which can be specifically combined with tumor cells enables a targeting effect of the polymeric micelle, and medicines can be targetedly loaded to a lesion; on the other hand, by glutathione responsiveness of disulfide bond, controlled release of the medicines can berealized.

column12: Polymeric micelle for tumor anti-inflammatory treatment and chemotherapy and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of high polymer chemistry and biomedical engineering, and particularly relates to a polymeric micelle for tumor anti-inflammatory treatment and chemotherapy and a preparation method thereof. The polymeric micelle is of a core-shell; polycaprolactone, as a hydrophobic core of the micelle, can load paclitaxel or other hydrophobic pharmaceutical molecules;and a shell layer is formed on the surface of the micelle by a matrix metalloproteinase sensitive polypeptide coupled anti-inflammatory drug and polyethylene glycol together. The polymeric micelle releases the coupled anti-inflammatory drug under the action of matrix metalloproteinase with high expression for solid tumor tissues, implements controllable release of the drug, carries out targeted treatment on the local inflammatory response of tumors, can be used for combined treatment of tumor anti-inflammatory treatment and chemotherapy, and greatly reinforces an anti-tumor effect.

column13: An isolated or a synthetic targeting peptide comprising an amino acid sequence that is at least 90% identical to SEQ ID NO: 8 is disclosed. The targeting peptide may be conjugated to a component selected from the group consisting of polymeric micelles, lipoprotein-based drug carriers, nanoparticle drug carriers, a chemotherapeutic agent, a micelle, a liposome, dendrimers, a polymer, a lipid, an oligonucleotide, a peptide, a polypeptide, a protein, a prostate cancer cell, a stem cell, and an imaging agent. Also disclosed are a kit for imaging and detecting the presence of prostate cancer cellsin vivo or in vitro, and a composition for treating prostate cancer, inhibiting prostate cancer cell growth, inducing prostate cancer cell cytotoxicity, and/or increasing the survival rate in a prostate cancer patient.

column12: Cyclosporine A drug delivery system for treating myocardial ischemia reperfusion injury
column13: The invention discloses a cyclosporine A drug delivery system for treating myocardial ischemia reperfusion injury. column12: Epileptogenic-focus-targeting lamotrigine polymeric micelle drug delivery system
column13: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnologies, relates to an epileptogenic-focus-targeting nanometer drug delivery system, and in particular relates to lamotrigine polymeric micelles based on the modification of tryptophan derivate (TD) as well as a preparation method and applications of the lamotrigine polymeric micelles. According to the invention, pluronic polymeric micelles being capable of being positioned to the epileptogenic focus and modified by the targeting head group, namely, the tryptophan derivate are adopted for encapsulating molecular hydrophobic antiepileptic drug lamotrigine, and thus the nanometer micelle drug delivery system capable of targeting to the epileptogenic focus is prepared. The prepared targeting micelle drug delivery system can effectively improve the brain-entering capacity of hydrophobic drugs, and after the non-invasive intravenous administration, the accumulation amount and brain-entering efficiency of the drugs in the brain are obviously improved. With the adoption of the drug delivery system, the capacity of the drug entering the epileptogenic focus of the brain is obviously improved; the system is suitable for promoting the accumulation of other hydrophobic antiepileptic drugs in the epileptogenic focus, and is beneficial for improving the curative effects of the antiepileptic drugs for intractable epilepsy.

column12: Hydrophobic modified bletilla striata polysaccharide drug-loaded polymer micelle and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a hydrophobic modified bletilla striata polysaccharide drug-loaded polymer micelle and a preparation method thereof. Bletilla striata polysaccharide reacts with a dehydrating agent and a condensing agent, and is grafted with a hydrophobic material; the reacting liquid is precipitated with alcohol, dialyzed and lyophilized to prepare hydrophobic modified low-molecular-weight bletilla striata polysaccharide derivatives; bletilla striata polysaccharide derivatives with different substitution degrees are prepared by adjusting the type of hydrophobic materials and the dosage of the bletilla striata polysaccharide; the derivatives and the hydrophobic drugs are dialyzed, magnetically stirred and ultrasonically dispersed in an organic solution, and are self-assembled into drug-loaded polymer micelle having a particle size range of 50-500nm. Results indicate that the drug-loaded polymer micelle can be stably prepared by the method, has a uniform particle size distribution, and can be used as a target delivery carrier for hydrophobic drugs.

column13: The invention discloses preparation of novel amphipathic pectin-dihydroartemisinin nano particles, and belongs to the field of bio-pharmaceuticals and nano technologies. The preparation technology and process are short in period, cost is low, operation is convenient, and wide industrial prospects are achieved.

column13: The present disclosure relates to a polypeptide based block copolymer having biodegradability due to peptidase, and a process for the preparation thereof, and polymer micelles using the same. column12: PH responsive polymeric micelle for mucus infiltration and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a pH responsive polymeric micelle for mucus infiltration and a preparation method thereof. PLGA and PEG are combined by a pH responsive hydrazone bond into an amphipathic polymeric combination, which is then assembled into the pH responsive polymeric micelle. Hydrazino-ized PLGA and aldehyde-ized PEG are dissolved in dimethyl sulfoxide to carry out reaction under nitrogen; the reaction solution is subjected to dialysis in N, N-dimethyl formamide for 12-24h, then the product is precipitated with ice ether, the centrifuged precipitate is taken and dried so as to obtain the pH responsive hydrazone bond connected polymeric combination. The prepared self-assembled drug carrier maintains uniform and small particle size, also has better biological compatibility and pH responsiveness, can achieve hydrazone bond breakage and removal of PEG protection under the condition with a low mucus microenvironment pH value to expose a positively charged group to undergo electrostatic interaction with a negatively charged cytomembrane, thus increasing endocytosis effect of the micelle. Therefore, more carriers can enter cells to perform controlled release of drugs to play the carrier role.

column12: External nano drug carrier system for carrying medicament for resisting periodontal pathogens
column13: The invention belongs to medicaments for resisting periodontal diseases, and in particular relates to an external nano drug carrier system for carrying a medicament for resisting periodontal pathogens. The existing medicament for resisting the periodontal diseases is short in drug effect, troublesome in treatment operation and poor in effect. The external nano drug carrier system consists of a nano carrier, targeted functional molecules and the medicament for resisting the periodontal pathogens, wherein the nano carrier comprises a biodegradable polymer material, surface polyethylene glycol modified nano-particles, liposome, polymer micelles and solid lipid nano-particles; the targeted functional molecules comprise RGD and a derivative thereof; an active group on the surface of the carrier is any one of maleimide group sulfydryl, amino group, carboxyl, biotin or avidin; the particle size of the drug carrier system is 10-1000nm; and the drug carrier system takes integrin on the periodontal epithelial cells as a target spot. column13: The invention discloses a surface saccharide-modified polymer micelle, and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the fields of drugs and pharmaceutics. The surface saccharide-modified polymer micelle has low toxicity, can achieve the goal of targeted drug delivery by identifying the cancer cell surface overexpressed saccharide receptor, lowers the toxic or side effect on normal tissues, and can be used as a delivery carrier for various anticancer drugs.

column12: Lipid-modified substance of chlorogenic acid and derivative thereof, preparation method and purification method of the lipid-modified substance
column13: The invention provides a lipid-modified substance of chlorogenic acid and a derivative thereof, and a preparation and purification method of the lipid-modified substance, wherein the lipid-modified substance includes the chlorogenic acid and the derivative thereof and phosphoglyceride. A preparation process includes steps of performing constant-temperature magnetic stirring reflux for a certain time to the chlorogenic acid or the derivative thereof and the phosphoglyceride with an aprotic solvent and drying an obtained reaction liquid to obtain a crude product. A purification process includes the steps of re-dissolving the crude product with filtration to obtain a filtrate and then drying the filtrate. The lipid-modified substance of the chlorogenic acid and the derivative thereof is high in composition rate and can significantly improve the fat-solubility of the chlorogenic acid and the derivative thereof, so that a subsequent preparation is convenient to process and shape. The lipid-modified substance can be used as an intermediate for preparing a lipidosome, nano particles, polymer micelles or a dendritic polymer and the like nano drug-delivery systems and micro emulsion, self-micro emulsion and the like micron-scale drug-delivery systems, thereby enhancing in-vivo absorption of the chlorogenic acid and the derivative thereof and further increasing the bioavailability of the medicines in a preparation.
